title: BlockingScheme
description: A blocking scheme used in a run play or as part of an OL protection package. Captures the per-position assignment rules and the scheme's strengths and weaknesses.

scheme_id.description: Stable identifier (kebab-case). Must match the filename (without .yaml).

category.description: High-level category for filtering and foreign-key validation.

description.description: 1-3 sentence explanation of the scheme — who blocks whom, when it is used.

assignments_by_position.description: Map of OL/skill-position label to short assignment rule string. Valid labels: LT, LG, C, RG, RT, TE, HB, FB.

pairs_with.description: IDs of run concepts, pass concepts, or formations that commonly use this scheme.

defeats.description: Defensive fronts or blitz packages this scheme handles well.

vulnerable_to.description: Defensive fronts, stunts, or blitzes that beat this scheme.
